login.title: Sign in to Duke Energy
login.description:
1. **On a computer:** Duke's sign-in only works in a browser that looks like an iPhone. Open your browser's developer tools and turn on device emulation with an iPhone selected (Chrome/Edge: F12, then Ctrl+Shift+M; Firefox: Ctrl+Shift+M; Safari: Develop → User Agent → Safari iOS). Keep it on while you sign in. **On a phone:** skip this step.
2. [Open the Duke Energy sign-in page]({authorize_url}) and sign in.
3. You'll land on a page that says **Not Found**. That's expected. Copy that page's full address (it starts with `{callback_prefix}`) and paste it below.

The link only works once and expires after a few minutes. If you take longer, reopen this dialog for a fresh one.

If you'd rather set the User-Agent by hand, use: `{browser_user_agent}`

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Duke Energy again
reauth_confirm.description: Duke Energy no longer accepts the saved sign-in. Your usage history is safe. Sign in again to continue importing.

error.invalid_callback_url: That isn't the address of the "Not Found" page. Copy the full address that starts with {callback_prefix}.
error.authorize_rejected: Duke Energy rejected the sign-in. This almost always means the browser wasn't emulating an iPhone. Turn on device emulation (step 1) and use the new link.
error.public_site_redirect: Duke Energy sent you to its main website instead of the "Not Found" page. That means the sign-in was rejected, usually because the browser wasn't emulating an iPhone. Turn on device emulation (step 1) and use the new link.
error.state_mismatch: That address came from a different sign-in attempt. Use the link shown in this dialog.
error.code_expired: The sign-in code expired or was already used. Use the new link and paste the address right after signing in.
error.invalid_auth: Duke Energy returned an invalid sign-in. Try again with the new link.
error.blocked: Duke Energy's network is blocking requests from this integration. Check for an integration update, or set an app User-Agent in the integration's options.
error.client_rejected: Duke Energy no longer accepts this integration's app credentials. An integration update is needed.
error.api_changed: Duke Energy changed its service in a way this version doesn't understand. Check for an integration update.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Duke Energy. Try again in a few minutes.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Duke Energy account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Duke Energy account than the one this entry belongs to.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. Importing will resume shortly.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Signed in again. Importing will resume shortly.

init.title: App User-Agent
init.description:
Duke Energy only answers requests that identify as a recent version of its iPhone app. By default the integration checks this project's GitHub repository once a week for the current known-good value, and right away if Duke starts blocking requests.

Only set an override if you have a newer value than the integration is using. Built-in default: `{default_user_agent}`

data.remote_user_agent: Check GitHub weekly for the known-good value

data_description.app_user_agent: Leave empty to use the shared or built-in value. When set, it is always used and GitHub isn't checked.
data_description.remote_user_agent: Turn off to never contact GitHub. The override or the built-in default is used instead.

error.invalid_user_agent: Use printable characters only, up to 300.

blocked.title: Duke Energy is blocking requests
blocked.description:
For over 12 hours, Duke Energy's network has refused this integration's requests. Signing in again won't help. Usually Duke raised the minimum app version it accepts.

The integration checks for a new known-good value automatically (unless you turned that off). Otherwise, update the integration or set a newer app User-Agent in its options. Your usage history is safe and will be backfilled once requests work again.

client_rejected.title: Duke Energy rejected the integration's app credentials
client_rejected.description: Duke Energy has denied the app credentials this integration uses. Signing in again won't help. An integration update is needed. Your usage history is safe and will be backfilled afterwards.

api_changed.title: Duke Energy changed its service
api_changed.description: Duke Energy's `{endpoint}` endpoint no longer works the way this version expects. Check for an integration update. Your usage history is safe and will be backfilled afterwards.

metadata_mismatch.title: Existing Duke Energy statistic doesn't match
metadata_mismatch.description: The statistic `{statistic_id}` already exists, but its settings differ ({fields}). Imports for it are paused so its history isn't overwritten with different units or meaning. Check Developer Tools → Statistics.

new_meter.title: New Duke Energy meter found
new_meter.description: Duke Energy reports a meter without any history yet, `{statistic_id}`, next to existing Duke Energy statistics. This usually means the meter was replaced. Its usage is imported as a new statistic. Add it to the Energy dashboard (Settings → Dashboards → Energy) to keep tracking consumption. The old statistic keeps its history.
